source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2, printed pages 145-146.

blocks.text: Chemical reaction ke dauran reactants products mein badalte hain. Is liye jaise jaise reactants kharch hote hain, un ki concentration (fi hajam miqdar) kam hoti hai aur products ki concentration barhti hai.

blocks.title: Reaction ki rate
blocks.text: Kisi reactant ya product ki concentration mein tabdeeli ko us tabdeeli mein lagne wale waqt se divide karein to reaction ki rate milti hai.

blocks.alt: Graph ke axes O-Y (saath oopar ki taraf teer) aur O-X (Time). A se B ke liye 'Concentration of reactant "A"' wala curve shuru mein unchi qeemat se tezi se girta aur waqt ke axis ki taraf chapta hota hai; 'Concentration of product "B"' wala curve sifar se tezi se charhta aur chapta hota hai. Dono par plot kiye nuqte hain aur dono reaction ke shuru mein ek doosre ko kaatte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: Reaction A se B mein waqt ke saath reactants aur products ki concentration ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 7.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.latex: \text{Rate of reaction} = \frac{\text{change in concentration of the substance}}{\text{time taken for the change}}
blocks.text_alt: Rate of reaction = change in concentration of the substance / time taken for the change

blocks.text: Yahan Δx bohat chhote waqt Δt mein reactant ya product ki concentration ki bohat chhoti tabdeeli hai.
Figure 7.1 mein yeh graph ki shakal mein dikhaya gaya hai: reactant A irreversibly (wapas na palatne wale tareeqe se) product B mein badal raha hai.

Shuru mein graph ka slope (dhalaan) sab se zyada hota hai: reactant tezi se kam aur product tezi se zyada hota hai. Reaction aage barhti hai to slope kam hota jata hai, yani reaction waqt ke saath sust hoti hai, aur aakhir mein dono curves seedhe (parallel) ho jate hain. Matlab reaction ki rate har lamhe badalti rehti hai. Yeh reaction ke mukammal hone ki stage hai.
Rate ki unit concentration divided by waqt hai. Aam taur par concentration mol dm⁻³ mein aur waqt second mein hota hai, is liye rate ki unit mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.text_alt: Rate of reaction = mol dm⁻³ / seconds = mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.text: Sust reaction ke liye unit mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ ya mol dm⁻³ h⁻¹ bhi ho sakti hai. Gas phase reaction mein molar concentration ki jagah pressure (dabao) ki units istemal hoti hain.
Aam reaction A → B ki rate do tarah likhi ja sakti hai: reactant A ke khatam hone ki rate, ya product B ke banne ki rate. [A] aur [B] in ki concentrations hain.
Δ[A]/Δt ke saath minus ka nishan batata hai ke reactant A ki concentration kam ho rahi hai. Product ki concentration waqt ke saath barhti hai, is liye us wali term ka nishan plus hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Rate hamesha positive number hoti hai. Δ[A] khud negative hota hai (A kam ho raha hai), is liye us ke aage minus laga kar rate positive banai jati hai.

items: Rate = concentration mein tabdeeli / waqt; unit mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (sust reactions ke liye min⁻¹ ya h⁻¹, gases ke liye pressure ki units).
Rate = −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt; curves shuru mein sab se zyada dhalwan wale hain, is liye rate waqt ke saath kam hoti hai.
